title: What the customer report says, and what it no longer shows
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work orders - View', on the build under test.
  2. A completed inspection with per-axle fields and a mix of verdicts; request its report.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a per-axle field prints each row's values per position with a status column carrying the row's derived verdict.
2. Confirm the report title reads 'Inspection results' and the template version does not appear.
3. Confirm the introductory paragraph and the three summary blurbs are removed, and the advisor row is removed.
4. Confirm per-section counts are removed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A per-axle field prints each row's values per position, with a status column carrying the row's derived verdict.
  • The report title reads "Inspection results".
  • The template version does not appear on the report.
  • The introductory paragraph and the three summary blurbs are removed.
  • The advisor row is removed.
  • Per-section counts are removed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9111 (S13 — Customer-facing inspection report); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S13; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R0: “A per-axle field will print each row's values per position, with a status column carrying the row's derived verdict”
  • S13-R1: “The report title will read "Inspection results"”
  • S13-R2: “The template version will not appear on the report”
  • S13-R3: “The introductory paragraph and the three summary blurbs will be removed. They editorialised, and they referred to trucks for assets that are not trucks”
  • S13-R4: “The advisor row will be removed”
  • S13-R5: “Per-section counts will be removed”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
